error[ZC-E0516]: a replica's health check could not run
  cause  the health check of hello-1 could not start: ZBX-E0501 the container is
         not running
  fix    read the runtime's code; the check runs again next interval
  more   zcube explain E0516 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
